title: Chocolate Hearts Box

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. Recent weeks show no sustained trend beyond seasonal noise. The baseline already reflects a -7% 13-week trend and normal seasonal variation. Past promotions had noise-adjusted effects near 1.0, and post-promotion weeks showed no lasting dip. Labor Day weeks (2026-09-07, 2025-09-01) sold at baseline or slightly below. The classical uplift model confirms no expected lift. No evidence supports a deviation from the baseline.
